sql: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*3\.75 years[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '30342298' LIMIT 5
rows: 2 mg twice daily) or matching placebo with an average expected follow-up period of 3.75 years (total treatment phase 5 years; 24 countries)
